subject: POC Kickoff: Scheduling Concierge & Success Criteria
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alice Park <alice.park@microgrid.io>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@microgrid.io>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: POC Kickoff: Scheduling Concierge & Success Criteria

Hi Alice & Sanjay —

Thanks again for the time last week. We’re ready to lock in a POC kickoff to validate inferencing latency and integration with your edge aggregator. To make scheduling straightforward across teams, can you confirm who from MicroGrid will need to attend? Specifically we want:

- Customer engineering (infra/network)
- Procurement (commercial/contract touchpoint)
- Security/compliance (data flow & retention)

Suggested windows (one-hour kickoff):
- Tue Dec 7 — 10:00–11:00 PT / 13:00–14:00 ET
- Thu Dec 9 — 10:00–11:00 PT / 13:00–14:00 ET
- Mon Dec 13 — 09:00–10:00 PT / 12:00–13:00 ET

Agenda (30–45 minute demo + 15–30 minute alignment):
1) Quick overview & success criteria (AE)
2) Live demo of streaming KV cache + latency profile (SE)
3) Integration checklist & infra dependencies (Customer Eng)
4) Procurement & SOW/QoS next steps (Procurement)
5) Q&A / next steps

I attached a short POC-Prep checklist and a calendar file with the proposed slots. If procurement/security require a different cadence or a pre-kickoff compliance run-through, flag that and we’ll schedule a 30-minute prep with your teams.

Can you confirm attendees and preferred slot by EOD Wednesday? I’ll coordinate invites once we have a confirmed time.

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: Calendar-Options.ics (calendar invite stubs)

Jonas — thanks for the clear plan. Two quick notes from our side:

1) Procurement and security will both need to attend the kickoff. Please include our procurement alias procurement@microgrid.io and our security lead Michelle Han (michelle.han@microgrid.io) on the invite.
2) We have a board review week the first week of December; week of Dec 7 is tight for our VP of Engineering. Would Dec 9 or the following week (week of Dec 14) work? Prefer Dec 9 if possible.

We’re aiming for a 60-minute slot so we can walk through integration and the SOW timeline. That should give procurement enough time to call out contract-specific items.

Thanks —

Thanks everyone — per replies we’re locking in Thu Dec 9, 10:00–11:00 PT as the kickoff. Calendar invite (Calendar-Options.ics) attached. Please accept if that works. Quick logistics and success criteria below:

Location: Zoom (link in calendar invite)
Pre-kickoff run-through: Tue Dec 8, 15:00–15:30 PT (Grace + Customer Eng) — optional but strongly recommended

Success criteria for POC (what we’ll validate during this engagement):
- End-to-end integration: Redwood agent deployed and connects to MicroGrid sandbox
- Performance: 95th percentile inference latency < 120ms for demo workload
- Reliability: < 2% error rate on 1k concurrent simulated calls during test window
- Observability: Console traces and token-level cost breakdown available to MicroGrid

Owners: Jonas (commercial & kickoff), Grace (demo lead), MicroGrid Eng (deployment & validation), Michelle Han (security questions), procurement@microgrid.io (commercial confirmation)

If any of the named attendees cannot make the slot, tell us today and we’ll shift. Otherwise I’ll send the formal invite and add the prep checklist to the invite notes.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Jonas Weber
